items.question: Which real estate agency did you use to sell your house?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Which real estate agency did you use to sell your house?”，自然应答是“The one that Luis recommended.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（The one that Luis recommended.）。
